I2C reservation conflict warnings, SPI removal non-exhaustive checks and directly callable GPIO HAL/LL demonstrate that ordinary API wrapping is not an enforced all-writer boundary.

later_host_only_interface_conditions.condition: Capture before any teardown, latch/mux/hold write, bus clear, reset or debug access. Unknown scope denies. No unique persistent boot/event epoch exists in current REV5B1 logs.

later_host_only_interface_conditions.condition: Prevent mutation outside one enforcing owner; registration tables or cooperative mutexes alone cannot establish this. For any unexcluded actor, keep BYPASS_POSSIBLE and deny the enforcement claim. No MPU/eFuse/privilege design is chosen here.

later_host_only_interface_conditions.name: freeze_and_quiescence
later_host_only_interface_conditions.condition: Freeze all producers before drain snapshot. SPI pending timeout is still potentially live; I2C wait-all snapshots are not producer fences; S3 bus_reset success is not HW-clear completion. Stop/abort evidence must cover actual peripheral engines, not just a task ACK.
later_host_only_interface_conditions.deadline: UNKNOWN. No timer value selected; task suspension, portMAX_DELAY lock wait or halt cannot be treated as a bounded response.

later_host_only_interface_conditions.name: disconnection_evidence_separate_from_ACK
later_host_only_interface_conditions.condition: request_received, owner_frozen, transaction_done, off_command_issued and END_TO_END_DISCONNECTION_ESTABLISHED are different messages/states. Never derive the last from GPIO42/47, EN, elapsed delay, FIFO return, bus IDLE or a software ACK.
later_host_only_interface_conditions.blocked_input: New stopped/committed A1 acceptance spec and approved source-grounded realization/enforcer; not read live.

later_host_only_interface_conditions.name: single_operation_grant
later_host_only_interface_conditions.condition: Validate atomically with the enforced gate immediately before the FIRST irreversible action, not just final reset. Hold disconnection continuously; stale proof/grant may not survive mapping/rail/owner/evidence changes. A callable lower layer without enforcement is still a bypass.

later_host_only_interface_conditions.name: deny_cancel_and_partial_failure
later_host_only_interface_conditions.condition: Before commit, deny means the operation did not begin. After commit, report cannot_cancel/partial and maintain deny; do not relabel it undone. No reset-as-recovery, blind replay, auto-clear or destructor-as-quiesce shortcut. A cancel ACK must say which stage/resources it actually stopped.

later_host_only_interface_conditions.name: rearm
later_host_only_interface_conditions.condition: Reset/return/timeout/host reconnect does not automatically rejoin buses. Requalify ownership and the adopted service proof first. Current log sequence resets per boot and boot_epoch=null cannot prevent replay.

later_host_only_interface_conditions.name: independent_progress_and_external_access
later_host_only_interface_conditions.condition: Any event that can halt/reset this CPU needs a gate/proof-retention path not dependent on that CPU continuing to run. UART log completion is not authority delivery; an already connected probe cannot be treated as waiting safely for an app ACK. No new physical transport or implementation selected.

later_host_only_interface_conditions.name: host_model_fidelity
later_host_only_interface_conditions.condition: Later model may exercise interleavings and policy under explicit assumptions, not prove physical isolation or exclude real privileged actors. Include negative cases: direct noos, shutdown-handler return, manual EN, late cancel, changed mapping, queued SPI after timeout, concurrent I2C submission, auto-clear, S3 clear query constant false, probe-before-request and stale epoch.
